prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 79.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 69.3%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 22.0%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Pet Personality Audio Preview: Redesign the pick_friend screen with playable audio soundbites of pet chirps and personality tags so users can listen before deciding. (why: Adoption step conversion is low at 69.3% with high mean duration (1017s) due to user hesitation during pet selection.)
1: [sign_in, incentive] Multi-Device Sync Benefit Prompt: Add a prominent account backup guarantee hint and multi-device sync callout directly above the sign-in options. (why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in, creating hesitation during the sign_in step (567s mean duration).)
2: [home, new_flow] Background Pet Creation Activity Feed: Transform the waiting screen into a dynamic visual activity stream showing sprite rendering, audio synthesis, and animation compilation. (why: The waiting screen has an extreme mean time of 2336s (~38 mins) as users leave or wonder if pet generation is active.)
3: [finish, redesign] Pet Habit & Sleep Schedule Selector: Redesign home_intro with a desktop activity schedule control card allowing users to configure active hours and tray hide hotkeys. (why: Support received 3 emails about unclear controls/hiding pets and 4 emails about desktop features misbehaving after setup.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Docking Sound Indicator: Add audio chime alert toggle and countdown visual timer on the waiting screen when rendering finishes. (why: Home step mean duration is 2336s vs 201s median, proving users tab away and forget to check back.)
5: [choose_path, new_screen] Welcome Story Prologue Screen: Add a new screen new_prologue_lore before story to introduce the world of desktop pets and build emotional attachment early. (why: Choose_path conversion is 76.2% and overall completion is 22.0%; starting with engaging backstory improves funnel retention.)

scores.note: Adoption has high dropoff and high duration; audio previews reduce hesitation.
Strong evidence from 8 support emails and sign-in dropoff; backup guarantee builds trust.
Waiting screen has extreme 38m mean duration; visual activity keeps users engaged.
Finish is the lowest-converting step (64.8%) with 7 related support emails.
Directly targets tabbed-away users on long wait step using sound and timer.
Adding a new preliminary screen increases initial friction without explicit evidence.
